# Component Catalog

> Local, bounded React/TypeScript component discovery CLI for AI coding agents. It indexes explicitly marked components and returns IDs, import paths, Props, constraints and usage without loading the whole repository.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/AleFlyX/component-catalog

## What it does

Component Catalog scans JS/JSX/TS/TSX component roots, reads inline JSDoc metadata, generates a JSON catalog, and serves bounded `search` and `get` queries. It does not start a server, render components, or replace runtime tests.

## Best for

- Finding an existing project component before creating a duplicate
- Getting the correct import path, required Props and constraints
- Reducing context spent reading a large component library
- Verifying catalog enrollment, freshness and representative queries in CI

## Not

- A Storybook replacement or UI explorer
- An MCP server or editor extension
- A full-repository index
- A guarantee of token savings for every task

## Quick start

```bash
npm ci
node bin/component-catalog.mjs doctor --installation --expect-version 0.4.0 --expect-skill-revision 12
node bin/component-catalog.mjs --config examples/basic/component-catalog.config.json generate
node bin/component-catalog.mjs --config examples/basic/component-catalog.config.json search 按钮
```

## Agent integration

The CLI is agent-agnostic. The bundled agent instructions are in `skills/component-catalog/SKILL.md`; any agent with shell access can run the commands.

## Validation

`npm test` currently runs 107 tests. GitHub Actions runs Node 22/24, packaging, and an installed-tarball smoke test. Documenso 51-entry and airport token benchmarks are local maintainer trials, not public CI benchmarks.

## Status

CLI 0.4.0, skill revision 12, config schema 2, catalog schema 7. Licensed under MIT. No npm release yet; use a pinned checkout or local tarball.
